question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the bracketed word to fill in the blank.**

There is a huge generation __ __ (void) between Arun and his grandparents.
solution:
The correct answer is: Gap.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

 
• Void: A completely empty space. (खालीपन)
 
• Let us look at the meaning of the given words in the options section.
 
 
• **Traditions**: A long-established custom or belief that has been passed on from one generation to another. (परंपराओं)
 
• **Gap**: A space or interval; a break in continuity. (अन्तराल)
 
• **Memory**: The faculty by which the mind stores and remembers information. (स्मृति)
 
• **Experience**: Practical contact with and observation of facts or events. (अनुभव)
 
 
 
• From the meaning of the given words, it is clear that the most appropriate synonym of 'Void' is 'Gap'.
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is option 2.
